demo.title: ici-trader.sh
demo.code:
# Arm a resting market-making ladder
bankr prompt "Using ICI Trader, arm a $500 ladder for WETH/USDC on Base"

# Check exits before entries
bankr prompt "Using ICI Trader, inspect my WETH/USDC position and check HIFO sell exits before buy rungs"

# Inspect revolving capital and inventory limits
bankr prompt "Using ICI Trader, show the inventory band and free revolving capital for my WETH/USDC position"

setup: Install the skill, then fetch its live contract with `run_app_script` before evaluating a pair
Fund the trading wallet with the intended pair assets and `$ICI` on Base for x402 strategy checks
Specify the chain, pair, and strategy budget when arming a ladder
Use server-side resting triggers; do not configure an interval cron or polling loop
